contradictions.details: GCEDC January 30, 2026 project summary lists total capital investment of $11.181B, while the GCEDC stakeholder overview and later local reporting describe Project Double Reed as a $19.46B/$19.5B investment.

Executive Order 62 applies to data centers consuming or capable of consuming 50 MW or more and directs DEC to hold incomplete discretionary permit applications in abeyance; local-government approvals are expressly excluded, so impact on the Town site-plan/GCEDC process remains unresolved in public sources.
